title: WhatsApp review write-side evidence check accepts explicitly withdrawn source consent
evidence: checkEvidence before this patch verifies source tenant/kind/path but not source.consent.given=false. Exact regression floor: store.test.ts tests 'withdrawn source consent refuses proposal insertion without candidate writes', 'withdrawal between proposal and approval blocks materialisation and retains pending audit state', and 'idempotent approval retry rechecks withdrawn consent instead of confirming old trust'. Each uses canonical detector output and actual Mongo repository against transactional fixture, withdraws source consent through its tenant-scoped updateOne, and requires rejection. Historical fresh-reader guard prevents trusted-read disclosure; write-side approval still needed refusal.
fix_direction: Refuse explicitly withdrawn consent in canonical checkEvidence; retain transaction and tenant checks. Await independent verification; no red execution claimed.

title: Concurrent source withdrawal versus candidate approval lacks shared version CAS protocol
evidence: Approval transaction reads source evidence then writes candidate and claim. Another transaction may withdraw source consent after source read while approval still commits under its earlier snapshot because no shared source revision/CAS exists. Conceptual reproduction: pause approval after checkEvidence source read; tenant owner updates sources.consent.given=false and commits; resume approval. No concurrent Mongo reproduction has run. Fresh trusted readers recheck source and deny withdrawn content; that does not establish write transaction linearization.
fix_direction: Central schema/integration owner must define source authorization revision and mutation protocol shared by consent withdrawal and approval (conditional revision write/CAS with conflict retry). Verify actual Mongo concurrent transactions. This patch supplies snapshot refusal only and does not close this finding.

title: Reingesting WhatsApp group overwrites withdrawn source consent with true
evidence: apps/api/src/whatsapp/store.ts builds consent.given=true for every ingestion and replaceOne overwrites existing source including consent. Exact reproduction floor: ingest group, update source.consent={given:false,recordedBy:'owner-withdrawal'}, unchanged reingest, assert source still consent.given=false and recordedBy unchanged; repeat with legacy bare-hash source id; simulate withdrawal immediately before source upsert and assert it remains false. Canonical candidate approval may then become visible again if consent is reset; no real database reproduction run.
fix_direction: Initialize sources atomically with $setOnInsert; preserve existing authorization/consent and metadata on reingest, retaining tenant-qualified legacy source identity. Adapt standing mock source-write fixtures without changing purpose or weakening assertions. Independently check original three-case floor.
